value.body:
From EXP-66, accepted 2026-11-14: an inference server is its own declared record, InferenceServer(name=..., serve=..., config=...), with batching defined on it and nowhere else; an EvalJob names the server its evals run on. Jack Heart: "the batching protocol has to go with wherever you define the inference server and then experiments need to be able to say, Run my evals on this [inference] server". It is identified by name and can already be defined in a module two experiment files import; this Task makes one running server serve both.
